title: Fix three bugs in Go string-check functions
description: Three string functions have bugs: IsPalindrome is case-sensitive, IsAnagram only checks one direction, and CountVowels skips 'u'.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in strcheck.go:
1. `IsPalindrome`: add `s = strings.ToLower(s)` before converting to runes
2. `IsAnagram`: after the loop over b, add `for _, v := range counts { if v != 0 { return false } }` before `return true`
3. `CountVowels`: add `|| c == 'u'` to the condition
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
